not_found.searched: IRCC publishes no list of the test's questions. "Study for the test" says only "We base all the test questions on information found in the study guide", and links the guide and its sample study questions.

"Study for the test" says a citizenship officer notes how well an applicant communicates if they are invited to an interview, but no list of interview questions is published there or on the test index page.
